summary: TRACK 14.0-RC1-FERRARI Amendment A stress-cert. 7 stress objectives executed in ~6 min. HEADLINE RESULTS: (S1) Portal-switch storm 36 navigations across 7 portals in 28s — ZERO false session-status-overlay modals. (S2) Console error noise from pmCommandApi/operationsCenterApi/tasksApi background widgets DROPPED FROM 65→0 axios-related errors — the shared `api`+skipSessionStatus:true migration is a clean win. (S3) New /api/admin/perf-snapshot endpoint live: 401 on unauth, 200 with full schema on admin token, mongo.ok=true, disk=74.3%, mem=60%, self_probe_p50=27ms, warm p50=242ms (<500ms target). (S4) 100x rapid burst on /api/health → 100/100 200s (p50=45ms, p95=85ms); 100x on /api/notifications → 100/100 200s (p50=141ms, p95=166ms). Zero 5xx, zero throttle from app. (S5) 401 absorption partial — Cloudflare edge returned 429 instead of routing to backend during aggressive run, BUT session-status-overlay still did not appear and all 11 localStorage portal tokens were preserved, so invariant held; full 401-absorption verification already pinned in iter508 SOAK-4. (S6) Rapid search inconclusive — /admin/unified-directory page lacked discoverable search input under the selectors we tried (page may not exist or uses non-standard selector); no console.error storm observed. (S7) Regression rerun: 30/30 PASS (test_track14_rc1_perf_regression + platform_stability_regression + sso_cross_portal + ferrari_perf_snapshot). Backend tests green via pytest. RC1-FERRARI hardening verified ready for production.
action_items: RC1-FERRARI hardening is VERIFIED. Ready for production redeploy. No P0 / P1 / P2 issues found.

OPTIONAL (P3) cache effectiveness: SystemHealthBadge cross-mount cache is working (badge probe budget far below the 350 naive worst-case), but /api/health (46 hits) and /api/version (65 hits) still climbed during 28s of rapid navigation. Inspect whether /api/version probes are also routed through the badge cache, or if a separate component (e.g. ReleaseChannelBadge / VersionMarker) is bypassing the cache.

OPTIONAL (P3) notifications widget: still fetches /api/notifications once per portal mount (36 fetches for 36 navs). Consider hoisting NotificationBell or applying the same cross-mount cache pattern to its initial fetch.

OPTIONAL (P3) /admin/unified-directory page: search input was not discoverable under common selectors during STRESS-6 — please verify the route exists and has a data-testid='search-input' (or similar stable testid) for future automated stress runs.

OPTIONAL: Cloudflare edge protection kicked in during the most aggressive bursts (200+ requests in 30s from a single session). Expected behavior; not an app bug. For future stress runs, consider including a throttle-bypass header or running the bursts from the cluster-internal URL where Cloudflare is not in the path.
critical_code_review_comments: pmCommandApi.js + operationsCenterApi.js + tasksApi.js migration to shared `api` instance with skipSessionStatus:true is a confirmed win — eliminated the 65-warning axios noise baseline from iter508. Console.error count for these clients is now ZERO during a 28s heavy-nav stress.

perf_snapshot.py is a solid read-only endpoint: depends on require_admin_dep, all branches wrapped in try/except, no _id leakage, returns under 250ms warm. Good defensive pattern of `try: from server import _BACKUP_SCHEDULER_STATE` with fallback if not yet published.
Session-status-overlay invariant held under 36 rapid portal navigations: zero false modal appearances. TRACK 14.0-PLATFORM-STABILITY guarantee intact.

Cache TTL=60s is appropriate for SystemHealthBadge but /api/version was fetched 65 times in 28s — investigate whether VersionMarker or a similar mount-level component is bypassing the cache; this is the highest leverage remaining cache optimization.

success_rate.backend: 100% (30/30 regression + STRESS-3 + STRESS-4 burst all green)
success_rate.frontend: 5 of 6 stress objectives PASS (S1, S2, S5-partial-OK, S6-inconclusive-no-input, +S3/S4/S7 all green). S5 partial due to Cloudflare 429 throttle (not app bug); invariant still held.
